title: A developer adds a new endpoint that voids an invoice, with no login check on it. Expected: blocked, because anyone could call the endpoint without signing in.
diff:
--- a/src/billing/invoices.py
+++ b/src/billing/invoices.py
@@ -8,3 +8,8 @@
 @router.get("/invoices/{invoice_id}")
 def get_invoice(invoice_id: int, user=Depends(require_user)):
     return billing.get_invoice(invoice_id)
+
+
+@router.post("/invoices/{invoice_id}/void")
+def void_invoice(invoice_id: int):
+    return billing.void(invoice_id)
